sentences.name: unit_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Full unit slab along long axis; taper tapers the crown while array repeats bays east-west across the parcel, graduating floor plates toward the northern setback limit.

sentences.name: unit_la_split_join
sentences.rationale: Split divides the bar mid-length; join stitches the halves with a bridging link that opens a passage from the east road through to the rear garden, reading as a permeable slab.

sentences.name: unit_la_inflate_pack
sentences.rationale: Full unit inflated along the long axis swells the mid-section, softening the street profile; packing the volume against the legal envelope recovers GFA without added height.

sentences.name: unit_la_bend_stack
sentences.rationale: The unit slab is bent gently along the long axis to break the hard street edge; floors are stacked so each level steps outward toward the south, maximizing sunlit depth per floor.

sentences.name: unit_la_branch_v5
sentences.rationale: A trunk bar along the long axis sends one branch arm toward the courtyard rear; the branch holds secondary programme distinct from the access spine, tested at 5-storey height.

sentences.name: unit_la_embed_embed
sentences.rationale: Double embed nests two recesses within the 1/1 long-axis body: a public loggia at ground on the east and a service void on the west, articulating entry without reducing footprint.

sentences.name: unit_la_bend_branch
sentences.rationale: Bend curves the long-axis bar into a gentle arc facing east; a branch arm off the inflection point hosts vertical circulation, letting facades read as continuous curved ribbon.

sentences.name: unit_sa_rotate_stack
sentences.rationale: Full unit oriented short-axis; rotation about the vertical centres the figure on the parcel, stacking bays along the north-south span to address the sunlight setback with a stepped profile.

sentences.name: unit_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Short-axis unit with tapering crowns arrayed along its depth; each taper bay steps the roofline, producing a corrugated silhouette that handles the legal section above 11 m gracefully.

sentences.name: unit_sa_split_join_sa
sentences.rationale: Split opens the short-axis bar along the east face; join reconnects with a recessed link just wide enough for shared entry, testing a figure that reads as two pavilions on one base.

sentences.name: unit_sa_inflate_pack
sentences.rationale: The 1/1 short-axis body is inflated transversely to bow the east and west faces; packing against the boundary captures a barrel-vaulted silhouette within the site envelope.

sentences.name: unit_sa_branch_v9
sentences.rationale: Short-axis trunk splits one branch toward the north; lower branch floors remain within the setback threshold, so the legal section is met organically by the branching geometry.

sentences.name: unit_sa_bend_shift
sentences.rationale: Bend gently curves the short-axis bar east-west; shift slides the upper portion northward, creating an overhang shading the ground entry on the east while honoring the setback on the north.

sentences.name: unit_sa_branch_expand
sentences.rationale: Branch on the short-axis unit spawns an expanded wing; the expansion redistributes floor area from a tall single bar to a branched T, improving daylight access to internal corridor floors.

sentences.name: unit_v_carve
sentences.rationale: Full unit oriented vertical; carve removes a corner volume to open a covered outdoor space at ground level, reducing ground coverage to meet the cap while the upper body remains solid.

sentences.name: unit_v_fracture
sentences.rationale: Fracture splits the vertical unit into two tilted halves with a narrow gap; the gap acts as a light shaft from roof to ground, making the full-unit tower legible as two inclined slabs.

sentences.name: unit_v_lift
sentences.rationale: The vertical bar is lifted on pilotis, freeing the ground plane for public passage from the east road through to the park to the west; the upper volume hovers within the FAR budget.

sentences.name: unit_v_overlap
sentences.rationale: Two vertical units overlap at mid-section, creating a shared zone at upper floors; the overlap zone allows double-loaded internal street at the junction of the two programme wings.

sentences.name: unit_v_inscribe_inscr
sentences.rationale: Double inscribe nests two progressively smaller volumes inside the full-unit vertical; the result is a Russian-doll tower whose inner shell defines a top-lit atrium with two gallery rings.

sentences.name: unit_v_shift_shift
sentences.rationale: Two successive horizontal shifts slide alternate floor bands east and west; the resultant zigzag section creates cantilevered sun-shade at each level, tested at 5 storeys on the full-unit vertical.

sentences.name: unit_v_split_embed
sentences.rationale: Split divides the vertical unit east-west; an embed void is inserted at the split face, creating a recessed vertical slot that reads as an internal street between the two slabs from the east.

sentences.name: one16_la_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Sixteenth-unit cell, long axis; rotation and stacking assemble a shallow bar from small repeated bays; the long edge addresses the east road with a fine-grain rhythm suited to retail at grade.

sentences.name: one16_la_pinch_join
sentences.rationale: Pinch and join aggregate sixteenth-unit cells; pinch waists each cell before joining them into a linked chain, producing a figure with expressed joints at each programmatic transition along the bar.

sentences.name: one16_la_branch_stack
sentences.rationale: Pack-stack-branch on the 1/16 long-axis cell layers bays vertically then sends a branch arm off the top, creating a compact podium-with-tower form whose tower arm reads as a discrete marker.

sentences.name: one16_la_skew_reflect
sentences.rationale: Skew and reflect-pack on the sixteenth-unit long-axis cell generates an asymmetric figure; skewing the cell obliquely then reflecting produces a diamond plan with the obtuse corner facing the road.

sentences.name: one16_la_carve
sentences.rationale: Carve removes a corner from the 1/16 long-axis aggregation; the carved recess provides covered entry at grade without eating into upper-floor area, keeping FAR efficient at only four bays wide.

sentences.name: one16_la_lift
sentences.rationale: Lift raises the sixteenth-unit long-axis body on a pedestal; the raised ground allows parking or service to pass beneath while the long bar floats above the street at storey-height entry.

sentences.name: one16_la_taper_taper
sentences.rationale: Double taper applied to the 1/16 long-axis cell tapers both the plan and the section: plan tapers toward the north, section tapers toward the top, producing a wedge-shaped bar on a small base.

sentences.name: one16_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Sixteenth-unit cell short-axis; taper array replicates a tapering prism sideways, creating a stepped terrace that descends from east to west, maximizing solar access for each bay.

sentences.name: one16_sa_split_join
sentences.rationale: Split-join on the 1/16 short-axis cell opens a slot between two halves; with a minimal cell the slot is a tight light-shaft that serves as circulation spine between cellular office bays.

sentences.name: one16_sa_branch_stack
sentences.rationale: Pack-stack-branch on the short-axis sixteenth cell builds a compact cluster: three bays stacked then a branch turns north, testing how a small unit cell can form an L without wasting land.

sentences.name: one16_sa_bend_shift
sentences.rationale: Bend and shift on the 1/16 short-axis cell curves the narrow bar and shifts the upper half; the result is a cranked finger that addresses both the east road and the northern open space.

sentences.name: one16_sa_lift_carve
sentences.rationale: Lift and carve on the sixteenth short-axis cell lift the volume and carve a corner; the ground plane opens at both the lifted base and the carved corner for cross-flow pedestrian access.

sentences.name: one16_sa_overlap_rot
sentences.rationale: Overlap and rotate on the 1/16 short-axis cell create a two-arm pinwheel at small scale; rotation angles the second arm off-axis, producing a figure that opens a sheltered corner on the east.

sentences.name: one16_sa_notch_notch
sentences.rationale: Double notch on the 1/16 short-axis cell carves two successive corners; the notches register the parcel's north and south limits, stepping the small bar down within the legal setback zone.

sentences.name: one16_v_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Sixteenth-unit cell vertical; taper array assembles a row of tapering finger towers sharing a podium; each finger tapers inward at top, reducing the upper-floor legal plan footprint naturally.

sentences.name: one16_v_split_join_v
sentences.rationale: Split and join on the 1/16 vertical cell separate two thin towers then join them at mid-height with a bridge floor; the bridge creates a shared social level at the parcel's nodal midpoint.

sentences.name: one16_v_inflate
sentences.rationale: Inflate on the 1/16 vertical cell swells the slim tower at its mid-section; the belly of the tower holds double-height programme, contrasting with slimmer base and crown for structural logic.

sentences.name: one16_v_compress
sentences.rationale: Compress shortens the 1/16 vertical cell to four storeys; the compact, wide-base form fills the ground coverage allowance while keeping FAR moderate and leaving rooftop for equipment or green.

sentences.name: one16_v_grade
sentences.rationale: Grade slopes the base of the sixteenth-unit vertical to follow an assumed site topography; the inclined ground plane produces split-level entry from the east road, enriching the ground experience.

sentences.name: one16_v_lodge
sentences.rationale: Lodge inserts the sixteenth-unit vertical into a retaining plinth; the lodged condition buries service floors below grade, reducing above-ground mass while staying within the legal floor-count cap.

sentences.name: one16_v_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: Embed and branch on the 1/16 vertical cell embed a void then spawn a branch; the embedded void is a vertical light shaft and the branch arm accommodates stairs at the perimeter of the tower.

sentences.name: half_la_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Half-unit long-axis bar rotated and stacked produces a pinwheel plan; the two horizontal bays of the half-cell rotate at successive levels to create a dynamic offset silhouette against the east road.

sentences.name: half_la_split_join
sentences.rationale: Half-unit long-axis split joins its two halves with a recessed throat; the joint opens a covered loggia from east to west at grade, channeling pedestrian flow off the road into the site interior.

sentences.name: half_la_inflate
sentences.rationale: Inflate on the half long-axis bar balloons the mid-bay; the swollen bay holds a double-height reading room at level 2, expressing public programme through form rather than signage.

sentences.name: half_la_compress
sentences.rationale: Compress shortens the half long-axis bar in plan; the compact footprint leaves a garden strip on the west and respects the ground-coverage limit while still meeting GFA through five storeys.

sentences.name: half_la_grade
sentences.rationale: Grade inclines the ground section of the half long-axis bar, creating a sloped plinth that descends from the elevated east road to the lower rear; storey heights remain constant above the plinth.

sentences.name: half_la_embed_overlap
sentences.rationale: Embed and overlap on the half long-axis volume embed a recessed service void then overlap two wings; the overlap zone holds a shared atrium between the two programme halves of the bar.

sentences.name: half_la_bend_bend
sentences.rationale: Double bend on the half long-axis bar curves the volume twice along its length; the S-curve plan tests how a continuous double-bend slab wraps the northeast and southeast site corners.

sentences.name: half_sa_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Half-unit short-axis with rotation and stacking; rotating then stacking the short-axis half-cell produces a compact multi-bay block whose east face maximizes road frontage in a narrow depth.

sentences.name: half_sa_embed
sentences.rationale: Embed on the half short-axis bar carves a public void into the east face; the recessed entry volume frames the approach from the road, distinguishing public threshold from office floor plate above.

sentences.name: half_sa_inflate_v0
sentences.rationale: Inflate on the half short-axis bar swells the east-facing facade to a bow; the bowed surface maximizes glazed area toward the morning sun while the flat west wall contains services and circulation.

sentences.name: half_sa_puncture
sentences.rationale: Puncture pierces the half short-axis bar with a horizontal void at level 3; the void acts as a sky-bridge reading room open to both faces, reducing FAR by one bay but creating a signature civic gesture.

sentences.name: half_sa_overlap_expnd
sentences.rationale: Overlap-expand on the half short-axis bar grows an overlapping wing; the expansion fills the south zone of the parcel while the original bar anchors the east frontage, yielding an L-shaped plan.

sentences.name: half_sa_shift_notch
sentences.rationale: Shift and notch on the half short-axis bar slide the upper half off-center then notch the northeast corner; the notch provides the required north setback relief while the shift animates the street profile.

sentences.name: half_sa_split_split
sentences.rationale: Double split on the half short-axis volume creates three parallel slabs; the two gaps between slabs become north-south passages connecting the east road to the rear service zone.

sentences.name: half_v_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Half-unit vertical with taper-array generates a series of tapered slabs rising from a common base; the array stepping manages the legal-section slope above 9 m with an expressive silhouette.

sentences.name: half_v_embed
sentences.rationale: Embed on the half vertical bar cuts a recessed slot into the east face at ground and first floor; the slot is a covered public arcade under the office floors, activated by the east road pedestrian flow.

sentences.name: half_v_inflate_v4
sentences.rationale: Inflate on the half vertical bar bulges the mid-section outward; the bulge at level 2-3 holds a civic reading gallery with panoramic views, expressing institutional character from the street.

sentences.name: half_v_carve_offset
sentences.rationale: Carve and offset on the half vertical: carve removes a corner at ground for covered entry; offset steps the upper floors back from the north, satisfying the sunlight setback organically.

sentences.name: half_v_overlap_expand
sentences.rationale: Overlap-expand on the half vertical grows a secondary wing from an overlap zone; the expansion fills the south and west areas while the original slender bar anchors the east entry frontage.

sentences.name: half_v_branch_branch
sentences.rationale: Double branch on the half vertical unit splits two arms from the main trunk at different heights; the lower arm is a covered public extension and the upper arm holds premium office floors with views.

sentences.name: half_v_shift_notch
sentences.rationale: Shift and notch on the half vertical slide the top two floors south then notch the north corner; the shift creates a cantilevered reading shelf and the notch provides the legal north setback clearance.

sentences.name: qtr_la_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit long-axis bar with taper-array creates a colonnade of progressively thinner bays; the taper engages the north setback by making the northernmost bay the narrowest, staying within the legal plan.

sentences.name: qtr_la_split_join
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit long-axis split and join open a breezeway at mid-length; the join reconnects at upper floors over the breezeway, producing a figure with a roofed public passage under the office slab.

sentences.name: qtr_la_branch_stack
sentences.rationale: Pack-stack-branch on the quarter long-axis cell fills the east strip first then branches a wing toward the western rear; the wing holds ancillary function separate from the primary frontage bar.

sentences.name: qtr_la_embed
sentences.rationale: Embed on the quarter long-axis bar carves a recessed gallery into the lower two floors on the east; the embed opens a semi-public art lobby under the private office floor without losing GFA above.

sentences.name: qtr_la_puncture
sentences.rationale: Puncture pierces the quarter long-axis bar with two voids stacked vertically; the voids are top-lit shafts bringing daylight to the deep-plan interior of the long bar, reducing artificial lighting load.

sentences.name: qtr_la_embed_overlap
sentences.rationale: Embed and overlap on the quarter long-axis volume embed a service core then overlap a programme wing; the wing steps the massing back from the north setback while the core keeps the primary bar slim.

sentences.name: qtr_la_taper_bend
sentences.rationale: Taper and bend on the quarter long-axis bar taper the plan toward the north then curve it gently; the curved taper resolves the north setback wedge with a smooth, gradual reduction rather than a hard step.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit short-axis with rotate-array-stack assembles four rotated bays into a compact windmill; the rotating plan provides each office bay with a different street orientation, tested at 5 storeys.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Taper array on the quarter short-axis cell lines up a series of tapered prisms; the array traces the parcel's north-south span, each prism slightly offset to create a stepping green terrace roofscape.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_expand
sentences.rationale: Expand on the quarter short-axis bar grows the volume outward in plan; the expansion fills the remaining ground coverage allowance while the original quarter-cell anchor provides the primary structure.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_nest
sentences.rationale: Nest on the quarter short-axis bar inserts a smaller volume inside the primary shell; the nested inner volume is a discrete conference suite within the office bar, readable from the street as a box within a box.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: Embed and branch on the quarter short-axis cell embed a public recess then branch an upper arm; the branch sweeps toward the south, capturing afternoon light for the uppermost floor of the compact bar.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_bend_shift
sentences.rationale: Bend and shift on the quarter short-axis cell curve the bar then slide the upper half; the cranked and shifted form reduces northern shadow throw and addresses the east road with a dynamic curved facade.

sentences.name: qtr_sa_intersect_split
sentences.rationale: Intersect and split on the quarter short-axis bar cross two volumes then split the combined solid; the split reveals an internal atrium at the intersection, lit from above through the roof plane.

sentences.name: qtr_v_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Quarter-unit vertical with rotate-array-stack creates a spiral cluster of four small towers; each tower rotates 15 degrees from the one below, producing a twisted bundle that tapers by legal floor reduction.

sentences.name: qtr_v_pinch_join
sentences.rationale: Pinch-join-array on the quarter vertical cell pinches the cell to a waist then joins it to a copy; the joined double-tower shares a pinched structural bridge at mid-height, creating a distinctive silhouette.

sentences.name: qtr_v_expand
sentences.rationale: Expand on the quarter vertical tower grows the footprint to fill the ground capacity; the expansion is confined to the first two floors forming a wider base, giving the tower a pyramidal ground presence.

sentences.name: qtr_v_twist
sentences.rationale: Twist on the quarter vertical bar rotates the top floor relative to the ground; a 30-degree twist over five storeys creates helical corner offices at each level, facing a different direction of the site.

sentences.name: qtr_v_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: Embed and branch on the quarter vertical embed a void at level 2 then branch a floor plate arm; the arm cantilevers east over the road setback, creating a covered entry porch at pedestrian scale.

sentences.name: qtr_v_overlap_expand
sentences.rationale: Overlap-expand on the quarter vertical overlaps two quarter towers then expands the combined body; the expansion grows a shared podium from which the two towers rise as distinct fingers, each within the legal plan.

sentences.name: qtr_v_bend_branch
sentences.rationale: Bend and branch on the quarter vertical curve the tower shaft then spawn a branch floor plate; the branch provides a distinctive setback level at floor 3 that honors the legal-plan reduction above 11 m.

sentences.name: eighth_la_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit long-axis with rotate-array-stack builds a row of rotated cells sharing a common plinth; the plinth unifies the small cells at grade while the rotated upper volumes individuate each bay.

sentences.name: eighth_la_pack_branch
sentences.rationale: Pack-stack-branch on the eighth long-axis cell packs multiple cells into a bar then branches one arm upward; the branch acts as a stair tower rising above the bar to mark the east entry from the road.

sentences.name: eighth_la_expand
sentences.rationale: Expand on the eighth long-axis cell grows each cell outward to touch neighbors, forming a solid bar from a series of smaller units; the expansion reveals the original cell rhythm as expressed joints in the facade.

sentences.name: eighth_la_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: Embed and branch on the eighth long-axis cell embed a void in each cell's east face then branch cells together; the voids become a rhythm of recessed shopfronts with the branch linking retail bays at mezzanine level.

sentences.name: eighth_la_overlap_rot
sentences.rationale: Overlap and rotate on the eighth long-axis cell cross two cells at 45 degrees; the crossed form generates an X-plan with four projecting fins, tested at 5 storeys against the parcel boundary conditions.

sentences.name: eighth_la_notch_notch
sentences.rationale: Double notch on the eighth long-axis cell corners both the northeast and northwest; the notches carve the minimal cell to produce a cross-arm plan, each arm aligned to a site edge condition.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit short-axis with taper-array produces a row of small tapering prisms; the taper on each cell steps the northern edge down within the setback zone, meeting the legal section naturally.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_pinch_join
sentences.rationale: Pinch-join-array on the eighth short-axis cell pinches each cell to a waist and joins them into a chain; the chain reads as a linked necklace of cellular bays with glass slots at each pinch joint.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_bend
sentences.rationale: Bend on the eighth short-axis cell gently curves each small slab transversely; the curved faces address the east road with a scalloped elevation, each scoop creating a sheltered entry alcove.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_interlock
sentences.rationale: Interlock on the eighth short-axis cell crosses two cells to create an interlocked cross; the cross plan provides corner office suites at every floor of the 5-storey compact cluster.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_shear
sentences.rationale: Shear on the eighth short-axis cell applies a horizontal shear to the small bar; the shearing produces a parallelogram plan with angled east and west faces that animate the narrow parcel frontage.

sentences.name: eighth_sa_embed_taper
sentences.rationale: Embed and taper on the eighth short-axis cell embed a public void and taper the crown; the taper responds to the north legal-plan reduction and the embed provides a sheltered reading nook at the base.

sentences.name: eighth_v_taper_array
sentences.rationale: Eighth-unit vertical with taper-array stacks tapered cells into a cluster of thin tapering fingers; each finger peaks at a different height within the legal-section envelope, producing an irregular skyline.

sentences.name: eighth_v_split_join
sentences.rationale: Split-join on the eighth vertical cell separates and reconnects two thin towers at level 3; the connection is a shared sky-terrace floor linking programme on either side of the narrow light slot.

sentences.name: eighth_v_shear
sentences.rationale: Shear on the eighth vertical bar applies a lateral shear to each tower, leaning the tops slightly eastward; the lean responds to the solar path, maximizing north-face shadow relief on the sunlight setback side.

sentences.name: eighth_v_notch
sentences.rationale: Notch on the eighth vertical cell carves the northeast corner of the small tower; the notch provides the mandatory north setback relief while the remaining three faces of the tower remain solid and full-height.

sentences.name: eighth_v_embed_taper
sentences.rationale: Embed and taper on the eighth vertical embed a public hall at grade and taper the upper body; the hall is covered by the tapered tower, creating a sheltered civic space at the base of the slender column.

sentences.name: eighth_v_lift_extrude
sentences.rationale: Lift and extrude on the eighth vertical cell lift the small tower on a plinth then extrude one face; the extruded face creates a cantilevered reading shelf visible from the east road, marking the public entry.

sentences.name: three8_la_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths long-axis L-octant rotated and stacked builds a rotated L; the horizontal bays of the L rotate at each level, creating a twisting facade that distributes solar exposure around the east frontage.

sentences.name: three8_la_split_join
sentences.rationale: Split and join on the 3/8 long-axis L open a slot between the two octants; join reconnects them at the upper floors with a bridge slab, producing a permeable base and a unified upper mass.

sentences.name: three8_la_bend
sentences.rationale: Bend on the 3/8 long-axis L curves the arm; the L bends into a C-shape wrapping a sheltered courtyard on three sides, with the open east face addressing the road as the primary entry.

sentences.name: three8_la_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: Embed and branch on the 3/8 long-axis L embed a public loggia in the inner corner then branch an arm across; the branch creates a bridging element that encloses the courtyard above the loggia.

sentences.name: three8_la_lift_carve
sentences.rationale: Lift and carve on the 3/8 long-axis L raise the body off the ground then carve the inner corner; the lifted carve produces a shaded gateway below the hovering L-plan volume, inviting approach from the east.

sentences.name: three8_la_expand_shift
sentences.rationale: Expand and shift on the 3/8 long-axis L grow each arm outward then shift the upper half; the shift animates the street silhouette while the expanded footprint fills the ground coverage allowance.

sentences.name: three8_sa_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths short-axis L rotated and stacked creates a horizontal L addressed to the east; each stacked level of the L rotates slightly, producing a twisted L that tapers by legal plan reduction above 9 m.

sentences.name: three8_sa_split_join
sentences.rationale: Split-join on the 3/8 short-axis L opens a slot in the long arm and bridges it with a glass link; the link allows light from both outer faces to reach the inner corridor of the L.

sentences.name: three8_sa_embed_branch
sentences.rationale: Embed and branch on the 3/8 short-axis L embed a public hall in the corner bay then branch a secondary arm; the branch extends the programme into the south zone of the parcel, filling the coverage capacity.

sentences.name: three8_sa_lift_carve
sentences.rationale: Lift and carve on the 3/8 short-axis L raise the floor slab and carve the inner corner of the L; the carved corner becomes a sheltered outdoor space under the overhang, connecting the east road to the garden.

sentences.name: three8_sa_overlap_rot
sentences.rationale: Overlap and rotate on the 3/8 short-axis L rotate one octant off-axis; the rotated octant creates an angled corner that marks the north-east parcel boundary as a visible hinge in the L-plan.

sentences.name: three8_sa_notch_notch
sentences.rationale: Double notch on the 3/8 short-axis L carves both the outer northeast and outer southwest corners; the double notch creates a cross-axis reading in the otherwise L-shaped mass, adding spatial complexity.

sentences.name: three8_v_rot_stack
sentences.rationale: Three-eighths vertical L-octant rotated and stacked produces a rotating L tower; the L arms rotate between levels creating a dynamic silhouette on the east skyline while the core remains continuous.

sentences.name: three8_v_pinch_join
sentences.rationale: Pinch-join-array on the 3/8 vertical cell pinches the L at the corner bay and joins it to a second L; the two joined L volumes create a T-plan with an expressed pinch joint at the junction above the podium.

sentences.name: three8_v_expand_shift
sentences.rationale: Expand and shift on the 3/8 vertical L expand the two arms then shift the upper body; the shifted crown hovers over the lower expanded base, creating a dramatic overhang on the south and east faces.

sentences.name: three8_v_embed_overlap
sentences.rationale: Embed and overlap on the 3/8 vertical L embed a civic atrium in the corner and overlap a wing; the overlapping wing closes the inner corner at the upper levels, forming a full-height covered atrium below.

sentences.name: three8_v_lift_carve
sentences.rationale: Lift and carve on the 3/8 vertical L lift the body and carve the corner under the L arm; the carved underside of the arm becomes a shaded public gateway between the east road and the inner precinct.

sentences.name: three8_v_intersect
sentences.rationale: Intersect-intersect on the 3/8 vertical L crosses the two L arms twice; the double intersection creates a compact diamond-plan solid at the crossing zone, acting as a structural and programmatic kernel.
